import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess

def w(n,o):subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py',n],input=json.dumps(o,indent=2),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
ids=set(map(str,json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text())['ids']));r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());assert set(r)==ids and len(r)==20 and all(x['credit']==0 for x in r.values());assert all(len(x['gates'])==9 for x in r.values())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='9e7891bb7178218e09c49458b32053c1eeb242233af47166c9f798c9d5960ebe'
ledger=[];previous='0'*64
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 e=json.loads(raw);assert e['seq']==len(ledger) and e['previous']==previous;previous=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();ledger.append(e)
attempts=[e for e in ledger if e['event']=='attempt'];successes=[e for e in ledger if e['event']=='success'];fails=[e for e in ledger if e['event']=='unavailable'];counts={mid:sum(mid in e['routes'] for e in attempts) for mid in sorted(ids)}
assert len(attempts)==12 and len(successes)==11 and len(fails)==1 and max(counts.values())<=12
for e in successes:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(e['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==e['sha256']
w('access-inventory.json',{'GET_hops':len(attempts),'successes':len(successes),'unavailable':fails,'per_ID_hops':counts,'ledger_chain_verified':True,'ledger_terminal_sha256':previous,'no_retry':'No request after denial for final journal body or alternate delivery. Inherited denials and r395 body quarantine not fetched/read. No access breach observed in this client record; this is not a claim of universal external enforcement.','payloads':[{'destination':e['destination'],'bytes':e['bytes'],'sha256':e['sha256']} for e in successes]})
b=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert b['calls_used']==3 and b['queries_used']==9
w('search-inventory.json',{'charged_budget':b,'actual_calls':[{'ordinal':i,'tool':'web.run search_query only','plan':f'search-plan-{i}.json','full_response':f'search-response-{i}.json','native_CPU_RSS':'unavailable'} for i in [1,2,3]],'plan_failure':'search1_plan failed assertion on existing initial search-budget after writing unique plan1; actual call1 followed charge_search1, no reset and no tool call during failure.'})
w('validation.json',{'exact20':True,'zero_credit':True,'reservation_SHA_rechecked':True,'original_raw_lines_rechecked':True,'guard_chain_and_payloads_verified':True,'search_budget_verified':True,'ordinary_proof_not_machine_checked':True,'mathematical_computation_performed':False,'jobs':'All supplied runner subprocess invocations returned synchronously; no background jobs started.','not_certified':'No new independent review, novelty clearance, formal proof or root acceptance.'})
print('Validated20 IDs/nine gates;12GET/11success/1unavailable;3search/9queries; immutable reservation and guard chain verified')
